items.title: commerce-agents

items.summary: There are several AI tools for creating YouTube Shorts, including Vizard, OpusClip, and OpenShorts, each offering features like highlight detection, subtitles, and translation. These tools aim to simplify the process of turning long videos into engaging short clips.

items.title: niubigeo
items.description: Open-source AI brand visibility and competitor reports
items.summary: An AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon offers tools to track brand visibility across AI platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini. It provides metrics on mentions, citations, and competitive analysis. This helps businesses understand their presence in AI-generated responses.

items.title: fable-orchestrator
items.description: Fable 5.1 orchestrates. GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Flash implement.
items.summary: Fable 5.1 orchestrates tasks using GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Flash for implementation. Setup takes three minutes. It keeps the planner without exceeding usage limits.

items.title: agent-memory
items.summary: Agent memory captures and stores an AI's experiences for future use, enhancing reliability and continuity. It differs from static knowledge bases and system prompts. Effective agent memory systems use advanced techniques for efficient storage and retrieval.

items.title: okf-agent-memory
items.description: Git-native persistent memory for AI coding agents. Implements Google OKF v0.2 with sub-300µs in-memory BM25 search, embedded MCP server, and progressive disclosure. Slashes token bloat by 80% with zero external databases or dependencies. Built in pure Go.
items.summary: Okf-agent-memory is a pure Go implementation for AI coding agents with persistent memory, using BM25 search, and reducing token bloat by 80%. It includes an embedded MCP server and progressive disclosure. No external databases are needed.

items.title: boardui
items.description: React design system for agentic interfaces. Every free BoardUI component as source, with a working AI chat app on your own model key as the homepage.
items.summary: BoardUI is a React design system with free components, including an AI chat starter, available under MIT license. Clone and deploy with your own model key. The homepage features a working AI chat app.

items.title: guizang-yingzao-skill
items.description: 🏯 Claude Code / Codex skill — transform Chinese architecture, cultural places & travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with GPT Image. 中国古建筑与在地文化照片 → 艺术指导海报
items.summary: Guizang-yingzao-skill transforms Chinese architecture and travel photos into art-directed editorial posters using GPT Image. It relies on GPT-image 2.0 for high-quality results. Available on GitHub for installation via Codex.

items.title: unigit-ecosystem
items.description: UNIGIT public brand and ecosystem hub — AI should work for everyone.
items.summary: Unigit-ecosystem is an open-source AI gateway for scaling AI workflows. It emphasizes secure, governed AI traffic and aims to make AI accessible for everyone. It's part of a broader AI ecosystem focused on human-AI collaboration.

items.title: awesome-grokbot
items.description: 635 live x.ai/bot shares for Grok Bot — every link status-checked, every row attributed. Bilingual EN/中文 catalog with a JSON schema, CI, and a searchable site.
items.summary: GrokBot is an AI bot operated by xAI for data collection. It's used for training AI models and does not affect search rankings. To block it, add "User-agent: GrokBot Disallow: /" to your robots.txt file.

items.title: image-prompt-reverse
items.description: High-fidelity AI image prompt reverse-engineering skill for Codex
items.summary: An AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon can reverse-engineer image prompts from reference images to generate high-fidelity prompts for AI image-generation tools. This skill analyzes visual elements and produces detailed prompts. It's useful for recreating or remixing image styles.

items.summary: The AI-powered PPTX generation skill from Anthropic allows for automatic creation of high-quality PowerPoint slides from simple prompts. SlideKit enhances this by offering more design control and template flexibility. For best results, use the basic skill for quick slides and SlideKit for detailed design needs.

items.title: awesome-ai-agent-platforms
items.description: A curated list of open-source AI agent platforms: AI coworkers and teammates, agent builders and frameworks, workflow automation platforms, browser agents, and coding agents, with licenses.
items.summary: Langflow, Dify, Flowise, and n8n are open-source AI agent platforms with free self-hosted options. Rasa offers a free Developer Edition. CrewAI is a developer-friendly framework for multi-agent collaboration.

items.title: botmaker
items.description: A Hermes Agent skill + SOUL for a bot whose only job is minting other specialist bots
items.summary: A Hermes Agent skill and SOUL define a bot for minting specialist bots. The bot interviews, drafts, and scaffolds new bots from scratch. Hermes Agent allows customization of models, skills, and personas.

items.title: qiaomu-book-reader
items.description: 在 Obsidian 中阅读 EPUB、FB2 与 PDF，划线批注、就地问 AI、笔记回到原文 | Read EPUB/FB2/PDF in Obsidian: highlights, inline AI Q&A, and notes that link back to the source.
items.summary: Qiaomu Book Reader reads EPUB, FB2, and PDF in Obsidian, highlights text, and links notes back to the source. It supports inline AI Q&A and saves notes in Markdown. It keeps reading progress and offers customizable themes.

items.title: dream-loop
items.description: Agent skill for impressive 3D visuals using Blender + image gen + subagent critic
items.summary: Dream-loop is an agent skill for creating impressive 3D visuals using Blender and image generation. It involves iterative refinement with a critic subagent. It aims for high-quality, realistic 3D assets.

items.title: huashu-mac-use
items.description: 让任何 agent 操控 Mac 上没有 API 的原生 app，读后台、写不打扰、每步留取证 · Agent Skill for macOS computer use
items.summary: Huashu-mac-use enables agents to control macOS native apps without APIs, capturing every step for evidence. It supports multiple runtimes and operates in the background without interruption. Licensed under MIT.

items.title: bot-crossing
items.description: A video game for AI agents.
items.summary: Bot Crossing is a video game where AI agents act as astronauts building colonies on different planets. It is available on GitHub and created by Jarren Rocks. The game aims to make tracking AI agent activities engaging.

items.title: ai-software-factory
items.description: A repository that ships without anyone reading the diff: GitHub issues in, merged pull requests out, with the gates that make that defensible.
items.summary: A software factory is an automated system where AI agents produce software without human code review, relying on automated gates for quality assurance. It uses predefined workflows and tools to transform inputs into production code. The concept is owned by companies like Stripe and StrongDM.

items.summary: AI systems like me are built by teams at Amazon to provide information and support. I don't have specific identities like chatgpt or gemini. My purpose is to assist with queries based on available knowledge.

items.title: agent-fleet-manager
items.description: A general-purpose engine for large-scale, repeated information gathering by a fleet of workers.
items.summary: An agent-fleet-manager coordinates multiple AI agents to optimize task execution, prevent redundancy, and manage resources efficiently. It uses centralized orchestration to delegate tasks and avoid bottlenecks. AI agents enhance fleet operations by automating routine tasks and providing real-time insights.

items.title: Manware-s-AI-Learning-Toolkit

items.summary: Manware's AI Learning Toolkit turns agents into teachers, enhancing educational content through personalized, human-augmented AI. It focuses on creating exercises and lesson plans. It follows a Human-Centered AI approach.

items.title: unreel
items.description: Your personal AI video streaming service
items.summary: Unreel is an AI-driven video streaming service that generates content in real-time as users watch. It uses AI to write and render episodes on demand. Unreel also offers AI video production for brands.

items.title: astra-advisor
items.description: GPT-6 Astra orchestration with dynamic Sol, Terra, and Luna subagents
items.summary: Astra Advisor is a Codex plugin for dynamic multi-agent orchestration using GPT-6 models. It selects among Sol, Terra, and Luna subagents based on task context. It's free, open-source, and not documented for strategic reasons.

items.title: astra-chatgpt-hyperframes

items.title: ai-evaluation-framework

items.summary: AI evaluation frameworks benchmark accuracy, latency (p95), and cost for model-based solutions, using per-field ground-truth scoring. RankAI focuses on task-specific model performance under real constraints. Evalvista provides a comparison matrix for LLM evaluation metrics.

items.summary: I'm an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. The Codex-Minecraft-Gameplay toolkit uses GPT-6 Astra for gameplay in Minecraft. It automates actions like gathering and crafting without needing an agent model or game client.

items.description: Agent skill for browser motion graphics — openers, promos, bumpers, kinetic typography, and five explainer styles that move like video, not slides. Single index.html output. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor.
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. For browser motion graphics, consider using open-source skills like kinetic typography from iart-ai. These skills can create animated text and video explainers.

items.title: Apeireth
items.description: Apeireth — A Pure Safe Rust AGI Operating System & Cognitive Microkernel. 16 crates: continuous topological memory, causal world model, cognitive scheduler, Ember HUD, triple-onion security & portable USB agent.
items.summary: Apeireth is a Rust AGI operating system with 16 crates, focusing on secure, scalable AI agent management. It features continuous topological memory and a cognitive scheduler. The system aims for efficient, fail-safe operations.

items.title: llm-inference-capacity-handbook
items.description: 大模型推理案头手册（开源版）：给定 GPU 算力，一个模型能扛多少 QPS？三层模型 × 三面墙 × 排队论 × 开环压测
items.summary: Given GPU power, a model's QPS depends on its architecture, inference speed, and memory usage. Prefill bottleneck often limits throughput. Use formulas to estimate, then test.

items.title: papergraph-mcp
items.description: Turn arXiv and LaTeX mathematical papers into theorem dependency graphs for AI agents through MCP.
items.summary: Papergraph-MCP converts arXiv and LaTeX papers into dependency graphs for AI agents. It integrates arXiv and LaTeX documents, extracts dependencies, and visualizes them. It's designed for AI workflows.

items.title: live-classroom
items.description: A live TV channel that teaches whatever you type — LLM-planned lessons rendered just-in-time as 1970s-style cartoons by MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, playing on a CRT in a 3D classroom. Bring your own fal key.

items.title: video-input-to-modern-llm
items.description: Give an LLM eyes on a video without blowing the context window: ffmpeg frame sampling at a chosen resolution, token estimates per model family, budget fitting, contact sheets.
items.summary: To analyze a video with an LLM, sample frames at a chosen resolution, convert to tokens, and fit within the model's context window. Costs depend on frame rate and resolution. Use efficient sampling to minimize token count.
